title: Undelivered (prologue theme)

loops.name: lower_works
loops.use: Exploring the depot and the dark lower works.

loops.name: order
loops.use: Rooms of the Order: the ration hall, the relocation lobby, signage and tannoys.

loops.name: heaps
loops.use: Among the dead: the racks, the heap, the queue line.

loops.name: failure
loops.use: Set pieces under threat: the slipping cage, a held moment of danger.

cues.name: lastcar
cues.use: DL-10: the relocation car leaves with the suitcase. The anthem's closing bars, then the world runs down as he rides the counterweight down (the run-down starts 3 s in and is gone by 10 s).

cues.name: collapse
cues.use: DL-10: riding the counterweight down, he looks down at ring C. The chime alone, the climb, the collapse, and the first bar of the lament.

crossfade: Every loop and every section sits on the same D pedal, tempo and bar grid. Crossfade on a bar line (a multiple of 4 s from a section or loop start) over 2 to 4 s. Loop each file from loop_start to loop_end.

scene_cues.name: wake
scene_cues.beat: Opening: power returns, he answers, stands, play begins.

scene_cues.name: hall
scene_cues.beat: DL-01: the dark depot hall, under the night-shift tannoy.

scene_cues.name: threshold
scene_cues.beat: DL-01: the bulkhead cranks open; through into the sorting hall.

scene_cues.name: racks
scene_cues.beat: DL-03: the gate opens; the rack lights come on row by row over the couriers.

scene_cues.name: kin

camera.shot: over his shoulder along the rows (the realise shot as now)
round to his face as he touches his chest (as now; settled by 5.3)
hold close on his face and chest
start a slow pull back and up from him: he gets small, the rows stretch away
arrive on the wide over the racks, easing to a stop over the last 1 s
hold ends; ease back to the side view over 2.5 s

scene_cues.notes: Stop racks (1 s fade) and the ambience at once; no voices from 0 to 21 s.

scene_cues.name: dead
scene_cues.beat: DL-06: the scanner refuses his label; the pit; the label check; purpose.

scene_cues.name: refuge

camera.shot: he stops and turns; the camera on his shoulder looking out into the dark (as now)
start the crane up and back (the vista shot as now, but driven by this clock)
arrive on the widest frame, easing to a stop over the last 1 s
hold ends; come back to him over 2.5 s

scene_cues.notes: Trigger at the awe stop (AWE_X), not at VISTA_X0; drop the separate refuge trigger.

scene_cues.name: ringc
scene_cues.beat: Moment (grief and horror), DL-10: the car leaves; ring C.

camera.shot: low beside him, up at the car leaving (car10, as now)
he lands; hold a beat in the silence
rise over his shoulder to look down ring C's lane, in the dark (ringc10), arriving by 9.0
hold; the cold light starts to come up over the lane
the light is full on the lane and its dead: the collapse lands on this frame
hold ends; ease back to him over 2.5 s

scene_cues.notes: Replaces lastcar + collapse with one cue; no queue. The light ramp ends exactly at 12.0.

scene_cues.name: child
scene_cues.beat: DL-11: the desk clears; the growth marks and the tree; no one at this address.

camera.shot: the marks shot (as now), held to 6.0 s instead of 2.6, so the true E lands on it

scene_cues.name: window
scene_cues.beat: Moment (intrigue and hope), the end: the one lit window.

camera.shot: he stops on the landing and looks up; camera still, low behind him (ending, as now)
rise with his look up the well
arrive on the one lit window, easing to a stop over the last 1 s
hold ends; come back down to him over 2 s
he checks his label (as now)

scene_cues.notes: Replaces end here; prologue_cue_end then plays on the end card after the fade.

scene_cue_notes: Play each scene cue at the loops' gain (level 0.9 at the game's current loop gain), since they are mastered together. Start it at once (its first bar is the incoming loop's texture; fade the loop out over intro_bars, or 2 s). At `handover` s into the cue, start hands_to from its loop_start with a 1 to 2 s fade-in while the cue rings out (its notes have ended; only tails and the pedal remain, and the pedal fades over 2 s). hands_to null means silence follows.
